name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM platform with OAuth and private app token APIs plus remote MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth access tokens for public/multi-customer apps; private app access tokens, both sent in Authorization header as Bearer.
gate_detail: Sources do not state plan requirements for creating private apps or OAuth apps. The MCP server requires the HubSpot account admin to connect first via a user-level app. Free tools exist per homepage.
api_scope: CRM and other HubSpot APIs on api.hubapi.com via OAuth or private app tokens; remote MCP server covers CRM records, activities, content, campaigns.
mcp_notes: HubSpot offers a remote MCP server and a local CLI-based developer MCP server; endpoint URL not given in excerpts.
blocker_detail: MCP requires account admin to connect first; some MCP features need Professional or Enterprise subscriptions. API plan gating not established.

evidence.quote: Learn more about using OAuth or private access tokens to make authenticated API requests to HubSpot.
